newsitem.title: USA: Coast Guard court-martial starts Monday in sex case.
newsitem.headline: Coast Guard court-martial starts Monday in sex case.

text.p: A general court-martial opens Monday for a 26-year-old Coast Guard technician accused of rape, sodomy, battery and adultery, Coast Guard officials said Friday.

Health Services Technician Second Class Darrel Stirewalt of Clemson, S.C., has been confined at the Naval Air Station in Pensacola, Fla., since the allegations surfaced in January. He will be tried on one count each of rape and sodomy, three of assault consumated by battery, four of indecent assault, four of maltreatment and four of adultery.

A Coast Guard spokesman said five women were involved, three victims and two who had consensual sex with Stirewalt. One of the two has left the service and the other received disciplinary action, he said.

The incidents allegedly occurred between October 1995 and January 1997, both onshore and aboard the Coast Guard Cutter Sweetgum based in Mobile, Ala., the spokesman said. Details of the incidents will be brought out at the trial, he said.
The court-martial will be open to the public but the military judge, Capt. Lane McClelland, may close some of the proceedings at her discreton.
Since 1991, 17 members of the Coast Guard have been prosecuted for indecent assault and six for rape, the spokesman said.
